ai.title: Steering hook accepts structured messages with images
ai.summary: The `drainSteeringMessages` hook in `loopAgentSteps` and the SDK's `RunOptions` now uses the `DrainSteeringMessages` type from `common/src/types/contracts/steering.ts`, replacing the previous `() => string[]` signature. Bun's `CPU:` header line lists the features it detected (`CPU: sse42 popcnt avx avx2`). avx2 in that list is Bun's own CPUID saying the CPU has it, so an illegal instruction on such a machine is not a missing AVX2.
Where probeCpuAvx2() gets its answer, recorded as the evidence for a pin.
A recorded verdict outranks everything below it. Every record now names its evidence: Bun's crash report, the OS probe, or 'crash' for an illegal instruction nothing could explain.

A record WITHOUT evidence was written by an older launcher, which pinned baseline on any SIGILL, including a bug on a CPU that has AVX2. Re-check those against the OS once: a CPU with AVX2 gets its record dropped and the optimized build back on the next update (see getDownloadTargetKey).

Positive evidence that this CPU runs the optimized build: a recorded verdict with evidence, or the OS probe. The optimistic default does not count. This is what lets a baseline install move back to the optimized build; without evidence, baseline stays put.
entries.title: Freebuff CLI 0.1.3
entries.summary: Freebuff CLI release 0.1.3 published.

ai.title: Freebuff CLI 0.1.3 pins baseline build on evidence not any crash
ai.summary: Freebuff CLI 0.1.3 ships the AVX2 baseline-fallback rewrite in `cli/release-core/launcher.js`, where `detectMachineHasAvx2()` now requires evidence before pinning a machine to the slower build. `crashAvx2Verdict()` reads `{ avx2, evidence }` from Bun's `CPU:`/`Features:` report or the OS probe (`parseCpuinfoAvx2`, `parseSysctlAvx2`), `recordMachineLacksAvx2(evidence)` persists the reason, and `knownToHaveAvx2()` feeds `getDownloadTargetKey()` so a baseline install can return to the optimized build on the next update. The pin record now stores an evidence field (`bun-report`, `cpuinfo`, `sysctl`, or `crash`), and `readCpuFeatureRecord()` re-checks older evidence-less pins once against the OS. New tests in `cli/src/__tests__/launcher-avx2-fallback.test.ts` cover pinning on evidence, cpuinfo/sysctl parsing, SIGILL on AVX2 machines not pinning, Apple Silicon never pinning, and old evidence-less pins being dropped or upgraded.
ai.evidence: In `cli/release-core/launcher.js`, `detectMachineHasAvx2()` now reads records via `readCpuFeatureRecord()` carrying an evidence field, `recordMachineLacksAvx2(evidence)` accepts an evidence parameter, the new `crashAvx2Verdict()` function resolves `{ avx2, evidence }` from Bun's crash report or the OS probe, and `getDownloadTargetKey()` now calls `knownToHaveAvx2()` to move a baseline install back to the optimized build; new constants `BUN_CPU_LINE`, `parseCpuinfoAvx2`, and `parseSysctlAvx2` are defined and exposed under `__testing`, with platform and `arch` destructured as variables in the test module. Version bumped from 0.1.2 to 0.1.3 in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` as a release-bump commit.

entries.title: Shared/Core update: agent-definition
entries.summary: Shared/Core, Agent Runtime, SDK changes across 9 file(s) (+223/−4).

ai.title: Model compaction respects per-model output cap
ai.summary: BYOK connections set `compactContext.maxOutputTokens` on every local template (sdk/src/run.ts), so a summarizer request that previously asked for 6,000 tokens against a 4,096-token cap is now clamped to the model's real output limit via `compactionOutputTokens` and `compactionSummaryBudget` (half the cap), because a capped connection would run out of output mid-summary. The stream now reports its finish reason through `onFinishReason` and `compactWithModel` throws before installing a summary whose finish reason is `length`, so a truncated handoff is rejected and falls back to mechanical compaction instead of silently dropping the rest of the session.
ai.evidence: packages/agent-runtime/src/model-compaction.ts exports `compactionOutputTokens` (clamp summarizer request to min(16,384, model cap)) and `compactionSummaryBudget` (now bounded by SUMMARY_OUTPUT_SHARE * output cap), with `compactWithModel` passing `maxOutputTokens` through to the stream and throwing when `finishReason === 'length'`; common/src/types/contracts/llm.ts adds `onFinishReason` to `PromptAiSdkStreamFn`, and sdk/src/impl/llm.ts calls it from the finish chunk; sdk/src/run.ts sets `maxOutputTokens: limits.maxOutputTokens` on every BYOK template's `compactContext`; tests assert 'the requested summary fits the output cap the request is clamped to' and 'compaction asks for a summary that fits the connection output cap and refuses one cut off by it'
ai.migration: If you author an agent with `compactContext`, you can now pass `maxOutputTokens` to cap the summarizer to your model's real output limit; existing agents keep working because the field is optional and defaults to the prior fixed ceiling.

changes.what: Added `compactionOutputTokens` and `compactionSummaryBudget` helpers that clamp the summarizer request to a model's `maxOutputTokens` cap (never above COMPACTION_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=16,384) and bound the summary to half that cap via SUMMARY_OUTPUT_SHARE=0.5; `compactWithModel` now threads.
Added `onFinishReason` callback to `PromptAiSdkStreamFn` so compaction can observe the stream's finish reason.
Threaded `onFinishReason` from `getAgentStreamFromTemplate` into the compaction stream so the summarizer's finish reason reaches the new guard.
Added optional `maxOutputTokens` to the `compactContext` shape on both the user-facing AgentDefinition and the backend AgentTemplate.
Added `maxOutputTokens` to the Zod schema for `compactContext`.
Sets `compactContext.maxOutputTokens` from the BYOK connection's `maxOutputTokens` on every local/published template so the summarizer request is clamped like any other BYOK request.

ai.title: Spawn agents results arrive as plain text instead of message arrays
ai.summary: The SDK changelog records that `spawn_agents` results from `last_message` agents now arrive as plain text, with each result's `value` being the child's final answer and a child whose last turn has no text reporting { type: 'error', message: 'No response from agent' }. The runtime enforces this in `outputForParent` within `packages/agent-runtime/src/util/agent-output.ts`, which `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agents.ts` calls as `value: outputForParent(output)`. A concrete constraint: the `answerText` helper strips think/reasoning scaffolding via `stripThinkScaffolding` before returning the parent's string, and `agents/file-explorer/file-picker.ts` and `agents/reviewer/multi-prompt/code-reviewer-multi-prompt.ts` drop their old { type: 'lastMessage', value: Message[] } unwrapping code to read the string directly. This change lives in the SDK surface (`sdk/CHANGELOG.md`) and agent-runtime/util layers, which is the area covered here; the changelog contains three other independently-worded bullets covering `run()` abort behavior and the `knowledge.md` to `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` file priority shift, which are not reflected in the diff hunks shown for this commit.
ai.evidence: The SDK changelog (`sdk/CHANGELOG.md`) adds an [Unreleased] bullet stating that `spawn_agents` results from `last_message` agents now arrive as plain text. Tests in `agents/__tests__/code-reviewer-multi-prompt.test.ts`, `packages/agent-runtime/src/__tests__/spawn-agents-message-history.test.ts`, `agents/__tests__/context-pruner.test.ts`, and `packages/agent-runtime/src/__tests__/compact-history.test.ts` assert the new plain-text and error outcomes.

ai.title: Add streak status line showing Freebucks credit and reset time
ai.summary: The CLI landing screen and chat header now render a new status line beneath the earned Freebucks streak perk note, reporting whether today's bonus +${bonus} Freebucks with your first message each day has landed in the wallet and when the next streak day starts, in the terminal's local time. The line is produced by `getFreebuffStreakBonusStatusForLayout`, which delegates to `getFreebuffStreakBonusStatus` in `common/src/util/freebuff-streak-line.ts`, itself consuming the new `nextResetAt` and `todayCredited` fields on `FreebuffStreakResponse` so clients never guess the boundary, which is why the change exists. A matching height-budget row (`streakBonusRows`) was added to the landing picker layout, and tests assert the rendering and the zone-aware reset copy, including the case where today's credit is in the wallet and the reset time is `3:00 PM` instead of midnight for Pacific readers.

changes.what: Added the re-export of `getFreebuffStreakBonusStatus` and the layout-gated `getFreebuffStreakBonusStatusForLayout` wrapper that renders the status line only when the perk note is on screen and fits one row.

Added `nextResetAt` and `todayCredited` fields to `FreebuffStreakResponse` so clients can report the next reset instant and whether today's Freebucks bonus already hit the wallet.

Added `formatFreebuffStreakResetTime`, which renders the next reset in the reader's own clock as midnight, a local time, or that time plus ` tomorrow`, and `getFreebuffStreakBonusStatus`, which returns the in-wallet / next-credit / send-a-message status using those fields.
